description:
[narrowed from route-edit-6b4da4c8] investigate and decompose gap reach-history-weekly-counter-inflated-beyond-total-executions-ever: In repos/activity-api/src/services/trace-retention.ts, rollupReachHistory can double-count weekly reach totals. Live evidence: week 2026-08-17 reports total=414944, which is 24x more execution rows than have ever existed in the retained store (17393).

READ THIS BEFORE PLANNING AN EDIT. The additive UPSERT is NOT the bug.

  reached = (reached ?? 0) + $reached,
  total = (total ?? 0) + $total,
